knowledge:
- key_parameters: query=A CpG set of interest, which can be a character vector of probe IDs (e.g., cg-numbers for arrays), a named numeric vector (for continuous queries), or a YAME-formatted binary file/vector (for sequencing data) ;; databases=The target features (knowledgebase sets) to test against, which can be pre-packaged databases retrieved via getDBs(), loaded from Zenodo RDS files, or custom-built ;; platform=The microarray platform (e.g., "MM285", "HM450", "EPIC", "EPICv2", "MSA") used to infer the universe set and coordinates ;; universeSet=Optional background/universe set of all probes for the platform; if omitted, inferred from the query or platform ;; alternative=Alternative hypothesis for Fisher's exact test (e.g., "two.sided" for both enrichment and depletion, default is one-tailed) ;; include_genes=Logical indicating whether to dynamically include gene enrichment testing with default or specified databases (default is FALSE) ;; max_distance=Maximum distance to link probes to genes in buildGeneDBs()
- alternatives: gprofiler2::gost()=Used for performing Gene Ontology enrichment analysis on genes linked to probes via linkProbesToProximalGenes() ;; sesame::testEnrichmentFisherN=Mentioned as an alternative/underlying implementation for significance testing and enrichment testing on sequencing data
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing DNA methylation data (from arrays like EPIC, HM450, MM285, or low-pass sequencing) to identify biological and technical features (chromatin states, transcription factor binding, histone modifications, tissue signatures) associated with a set of differentially methylated or trait-correlated CpGs.
- pitfalls: Selecting an inappropriate background/universe set can significantly bias and impact the interpretation of enrichment results ;; Large query/database sizes can cause integer overflow warnings during Fisher's exact test calculations (e.g., nDQ * nUmDQ producing NAs) ;; Sequencing-based workflows require the external yame tool installed in the shell PATH; otherwise, R-based wrappers or system calls will fail ;; Forgetting to run sesameDataCache() once per installation can lead to slow database loading times or download failures during getDBs() calls.

workflows.name: array_discrete_enrichment
workflows.intent: Test a discrete set of CpG probe IDs (e.g., from Illumina arrays) for enrichment against categorical database sets using Fisher's exact test and visualize the results.
workflows.stages: 1. Cache required database sets using sesameDataCache() ;; 2. Retrieve query CpG list (or define custom list) ;; 3. Run enrichment testing using testEnrichment() ;; 4. Visualize results using KYCG_plotDot(), KYCG_plotVolcano(), or KYCG_plotManhattan().
workflows.code:
library (knowYourCG)
library (sesameData)
sesameDataCache ( data_titles= c ( "genomeInfo.hg38" , "genomeInfo.mm10" , "KYCG.MM285.tissueSignature.20211211" , "MM285.tissueSignature" , "MM285.address" , "probeIDSignature" , "KYCG.MM285.designGroup.20210210" , "KYCG.MM285.chromHMM.20210210" , "KYCG.MM285.TFBSconsensus.20220116" , "KYCG.MM285.HMconsensus.20220116" , "KYCG.MM285.chromosome.mm10.20210630" ))
query <- getDBs ( "MM285.designGroup" )[[ "PGCMeth" ]]
dbs <- c ( "KYCG.MM285.chromHMM.20210210" , "KYCG.HM450.TFBSconsensus.20211013" , "KYCG.MM285.HMconsensus.20220116" , "KYCG.MM285.tissueSignature.20211211" , "KYCG.MM285.chromosome.mm10.20210630" , "KYCG.MM285.designGroup.20210210" )
results_pgc <- testEnrichment (query, databases = dbs, platform= "MM285" )
library (SummarizedExperiment)
library (sesame)
sesameDataCache ( "MM285.tissueSignature" )
kycgDataCache ()
df <- rowData ( sesameDataGet ( 'MM285.tissueSignature' ))
query <- df $ Probe_ID[df $ branch == "fetal_liver" & df $ type == "Hypo" ]
results <- testEnrichment (query, "TFBS" )
KYCG_plotDot (results)
query <- df $ Probe_ID[df $ branch == "fetal_brain" & df $ type == "Hypo" ]
results_2tailed <- testEnrichment (query, "TFBS" , alternative = "two.sided" )
KYCG_plotVolcano (results_2tailed)
library (ggrepel)
smry_pvals = readRDS ( url ( paste0 ( "https://zenodo.org/records/" , "18176501/files/20220413_testManhattan.rds" )))
KYCG_plotManhattan ( - log10 (smry_pvals), platform= "HM450" , title= "Differentially Methylated CpGs - EWAS Aging" , col= c ( "navy" , "skyblue" ), ylabel = bquote ( - log[ 10 ](P ~ value)), label_min= 30 ) + theme ( axis.text.x = element_text ( angle = 90 , vjust = 0.5 , hjust= 1 ))

workflows.name: sequencing_discrete_enrichment
workflows.intent: Convert genomic coordinates (BED format) to coordinate-free YAME format and test for enrichment against a knowledgebase.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert BED file to YAME-compressed binary vector using bedToCg() ;; 2. Run enrichment testing using testEnrichment() with the YAME query and knowledgebase ;; 3. Plot results using KYCG_plotDot().
workflows.code:
library (knowYourCG)
temp_dir <- tempdir ()
knowledgebase <- file.path (temp_dir, "ChromHMM.20220414.cm" )
query <- file.path (temp_dir, "mm10_f3_10cells.cg" )
knowledgebase_url <- "https://zenodo.org/records/18175656/files/ChromHMM.20220414.cm"
query_url <- "https://zenodo.org/records/18176004/files/mm10_f3_10cells.cg"
download.file (knowledgebase_url, destfile = knowledgebase)
download.file (query_url, destfile = query)
res = testEnrichment (query, knowledgebase)
KYCG_plotDot (res, short_label= TRUE )
bed_file <- "input_cpgs.bed"
ref_cr <- "cpg_nocontig.cr"
out_file <- "input_cpgs.cg"
bedToCg (bed_file, ref_cr, out_file)

workflows.name: continuous_enrichment_sea
workflows.intent: Perform Set Enrichment Analysis (SEA) using a continuous query (e.g., beta values or continuous genomic metrics) against discrete or continuous databases.
input: beta_values (named numeric vector of methylation levels)
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve continuous query (e.g., beta values from a sample) ;; 2. Run Set Enrichment Analysis against a database group using testEnrichmentSEA().
workflows.code:
library (knowYourCG)
query <- getDBs ( "KYCG.MM285.designGroup" )[[ "TSS" ]]
sesameDataCache ( data_titles = c ( "KYCG.MM285.seqContextN.20210630" ))
res <- testEnrichmentSEA (query, "MM285.seqContextN" )
library (sesame)
sesameDataCache ( data_titles = c ( "MM285.1.SigDF" ))
beta_values <- getBetas ( sesameDataGet ( "MM285.1.SigDF" ))
res <- testEnrichmentSEA (beta_values, "MM285.chromHMM" )

workflows.name: genomic_proximity_and_linkage
workflows.intent: Link a set of CpG probes to proximal genes and perform Gene Ontology enrichment analysis, or test whether a query set of CpG probes shares close genomic proximity.
input: query_probes (character vector of CpG probe IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Link query probes to proximal genes using linkProbesToProximalGenes() ;; 2. Perform Gene Ontology enrichment on the linked genes using gprofiler2::gost() ;; 3. Test for genomic proximity and co-localization using testProbeProximity().
workflows.code:
library (knowYourCG)
library (sesameData)
library (SummarizedExperiment)
df <- rowData (sesameData :: sesameDataGet ( 'MM285.tissueSignature' ))
query_probes <- df $ Probe_ID[df $ branch == "fetal_liver" & df $ type == "Hypo" ]
genes <- linkProbesToProximalGenes (query_probes, platform = "MM285" ) $ gene_name
library (gprofiler2)
gostres <- gprofiler2 :: gost (genes, organism = "mmusculus" )
probes <- df $ Probe_ID[df $ branch == "fetal_liver" & df $ type == "Hypo" ]
res <- testProbeProximity ( probeIDs= probes)

workflows.name: feature_aggregation_and_annotation
workflows.intent: Aggregate CpG-level beta values into database-level summary statistics (e.g., mean) for downstream modeling, or annotate an arbitrary probe set.
input: betas (numeric matrix of beta values with probes as rows and samples as columns)
query (character vector of probe IDs to annotate)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate summary statistics (e.g., mean) across database sets using dbStats() ;; 2. Annotate an arbitrary probe set using annoProbes().
workflows.code:
library (knowYourCG)
library (sesameData)
library (SummarizedExperiment)
betas = assay ( sesameDataGet ( 'MM285.467.SE.tissue20Kprobes' ))
stats <- dbStats (betas, 'MM285.chromHMM' )
query <- names ( sesameData_getManifestGRanges ( "MM285" ))
anno <- annoProbes (query, "designGroup" , silent = TRUE )
